reason: A session-aware terminal UI for interacting with DeepSeek Harness coding-agent sessions, including streaming responses, tool approvals, session management, permission visibility, and optional Herdr integration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话感知的终端界面，用于交互式运行编码智能体、查看工具活动、处理审批并管理项目会话。
summaries.en: A session-aware terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness that supports interactive coding-agent runs, tool activity and approval handling, and project session management.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness sessions
Streams agent text, reasoning, tool activity, approvals, and user questions
Creates, resumes, switches, and persists sessions by project directory
Displays and changes the current DSH permission preset through official commands
Reports lifecycle state to Herdr when running in a Herdr-managed pane
Optionally checks the official npm registry for DSH updates
